metadata.title: u dont GRC me - control inventory
metadata.remarks: Generated from the u dont GRC me prototype control graph by npm run export:oscal. Prototype data, not an assurance artifact.

components.title: Business Continuity Exercise
components.description: Critical services have documented recovery procedures and tested continuity exercises with tracked remediation.
components.purpose: Corrective control owned by Business Resilience.

components.title: Centralized Security Logging
components.description: Security-relevant system, identity, and cloud logs are centralized, retained, monitored, and available for investigation.
components.purpose: Detective control owned by Detection Engineering.

control-implementations.description: Centralized Security Logging as implemented against NIST CSF.

implemented-requirements.description: Central logs support monitoring of user and system activity.

components.title: Critical Vulnerability Remediation
components.description: Critical vulnerabilities on internet-facing production assets are remediated or formally risk accepted within SLA.
components.purpose: Corrective control owned by Platform Engineering.

control-implementations.description: Critical Vulnerability Remediation as implemented against ISO 27001.

implemented-requirements.description: Remediation workflow covers vulnerabilities but needs EOL replacement criteria.

control-implementations.description: Critical Vulnerability Remediation as implemented against SOC 2.

implemented-requirements.description: Security findings are monitored, but SLA misses are currently degraded.

components.title: Encryption at Rest
components.description: Sensitive data stores use approved encryption at rest with managed keys and monitored configuration drift.
components.purpose: Preventive control owned by Cloud Security.

control-implementations.description: Encryption at Rest as implemented against ISO 27001.

implemented-requirements.description: Encryption and key controls are continuously checked.

control-implementations.description: Encryption at Rest as implemented against PCI DSS.

implemented-requirements.description: Key management coverage is strong but needs PCI-specific custodian evidence.

components.title: Endpoint Protection Coverage
components.description: Managed endpoints run approved protection, report health, and automatically create remediation tasks for stale agents.
components.purpose: Detective control owned by Security Operations.

control-implementations.description: Endpoint Protection Coverage as implemented against SOC 2.

implemented-requirements.description: Endpoint posture is stale on a subset of devices.

components.title: Identity Lifecycle Review
components.description: Joiner, mover, and leaver access is reviewed against HR source-of-truth and deprovisioning evidence.
components.purpose: Detective control owned by IT Operations.

control-implementations.description: Identity Lifecycle Review as implemented against HIPAA.

implemented-requirements.description: Unique workforce identities are linked to access review evidence.

control-implementations.description: Identity Lifecycle Review as implemented against SOC 2.

implemented-requirements.description: Lifecycle reviews remove access when business need ends.

components.title: Immutable Evidence Retention
components.description: Control evidence is written to object-locked storage with version identifiers, hash validation, retention policy, and graph edge traceability.
components.purpose: Preventive control owned by GRC Platform.

control-implementations.description: Immutable Evidence Retention as implemented against SOC 2.

implemented-requirements.description: Immutable evidence proves monitoring outcomes and decision traceability.

components.title: Privileged Access Management
components.description: Administrative access to production systems is brokered through a managed vault, requires MFA, and records every privileged session.
components.purpose: Preventive control owned by Security Operations.

control-implementations.description: Privileged Access Management as implemented against ISO 27001.

implemented-requirements.description: Human privileged access is covered; service identities need an explicit subcontrol.

control-implementations.description: Privileged Access Management as implemented against NIST CSF.

implemented-requirements.description: Identity and credentials are governed through vaulting and MFA.

control-implementations.description: Privileged Access Management as implemented against SOC 2.

implemented-requirements.description: PAM, MFA, and session recording strongly satisfy logical access requirements.

components.title: Production Change Management
components.description: Production changes require approval, linked tickets, testing evidence, and emergency change review.
components.purpose: Directive control owned by Platform Operations.

control-implementations.description: Production Change Management as implemented against SOC 2.

implemented-requirements.description: Change approvals and linked tickets satisfy change management.

components.title: Protected Production Branches
components.description: Production repositories enforce branch protection, required reviews, and restricted admin bypass.
components.purpose: Preventive control owned by Application Security.

control-implementations.description: Protected Production Branches as implemented against SOC 2.

implemented-requirements.description: Branch protections enforce review before production change.

components.title: Security Awareness Training
components.description: Employees and privileged users complete security awareness training within policy-defined windows.
components.purpose: Directive control owned by People Security.

control-implementations.description: Security Awareness Training as implemented against SOC 2.

implemented-requirements.description: Training supports access responsibilities for privileged users.

components.title: Tier 1 Vendor Security Review
components.description: Tier 1 vendors are assessed before onboarding and annually thereafter using SOC 2, security questionnaire, breach history, and data processing scope.
components.purpose: Detective control owned by Third-Party Risk.

control-implementations.description: Tier 1 Vendor Security Review as implemented against NIST CSF.

implemented-requirements.description: Vendor assessment exists; continuous monitoring is not complete.
